title: 第1章 做梦就要有做梦的样子第2章 我不许你找道侣
slug: 什么梦中的娘子都是真的
content_zh:
【最终，你被血魔宗弟子祭炼成一缕冤魂，收入招魂幡内。
【享年18岁。
【本次梦境结束。
【随机获得梦境人生能力：入门级书法。
【此次梦境评价，普通。
一个幽暗的房间内。
叶羽猛然睁开双眼，大口大口的喘着粗气。
那种濒死的感觉，太过真实。
让人不免有些心有余悸。
可紧随而来的，就是极度不爽的情绪。
淦！
入门级书法有什么用？
叶羽想要的，是修为、是功法、是仙器！
否则在这玄幻的世界中，真的很没有安全感。
三年前。
叶羽穿越到这方天地。
在目睹空中御剑而行的修士后。
心中澎湃不已。
立志要开始修仙，从此快意天地，寿与天齐。
经过多方打听，摸爬滚打，机缘巧合。

叶羽来到了中洲大陆五大圣地之一的青云宗。
好消息是：他成功加入青云宗，成为其门下弟子。
坏消息是：因天赋不够，所以只是外门弟子，且有很大概率一辈子也无法跻身练气境后期，成为内门弟子。
现如今。
叶羽凭借着亿点点人情世故，拿到了外门弟子中，最轻松的活。
看管灵田。
一个人照看五亩。
只需三日一浇水即可。
这样的生活一眼看到头。
做满三十年后，青云宗会给出一笔不菲的银钱。
足够叶羽后半生衣食无忧。
从此孤独老去。
但叶羽好不容易穿越一次。
自然不愿意就这么平淡的活下去。
好在两个时辰前。
梦境模拟系统的降临，让叶羽看到了新的希望。
梦境模拟系统。
每天有两次模拟的机会。
宿主可亲身体验其中的所有事物。
一切在梦中，都宛如真实发生一般。
content_en:
[In the end, you were sacrificed by the disciples of the Blood Demon Sect and turned into a wisp of wronged soul, which was stored in the soul summoning flag.
[Aged 18 years old.
[This dream is over.
[Randomly obtain the dream life ability: entry-level calligraphy.
[The evaluation of this dream is average.
In a dark room.
Ye Yu suddenly opened his eyes, breathing heavily.
The feeling of dying is too real.
It makes people feel a little scared.
But what followed immediately was an extremely unhappy mood.
Gan!
What is the use of entry-level calligraphy?
What Ye Yu wants is cultivation, skills, and immortal weapons!
Otherwise, you really feel insecure in this fantasy world.
three years ago.
Ye Yu traveled to this world.
After witnessing the monk wielding a sword in the air.
My heart was filled with excitement.
Determine to start cultivating immortals, and from then on you will be happy with heaven and earth, and your life will be as long as heaven.
After much inquiry and trial and error, it just happened by chance.
Ye Yu came to Qingyun Sect, one of the five holy places in Central Continent.
The good news is: he successfully joined the Qingyun Sect and became its disciple.
The bad news is: because he is not talented enough, he is only an outer disciple, and there is a high probability that he will not be able to reach the late stage of the Qi training realm and become an inner disciple.
Today.
Ye Yu got the easiest job among the outer disciples by relying on hundreds of millions of people and worldly knowledge.
Take care of the spiritual field.
One person looks after five acres.
Just water once every three days.
This kind of life can be seen at a glance.
After thirty years of service, Qingyun Sect will give a large sum of money.
It was enough for Ye Yu to have enough food and clothing for the rest of his life.
From now on I grow old alone.
But Ye Yu finally traveled through time.
Naturally, I don’t want to live in such a plain way.
Fortunately, it was two hours ago.
The arrival of the dream simulation system gave Ye Yu new hope.
Dream simulation system.
There are two simulation opportunities per day.
The host can experience everything there firsthand.
Everything in the dream is as if it really happened.
